source: Regimental histories & published compendia — 34th NY Infantry

entries.title: Louis N. Chapin, A Brief History of the Thirty-Fourth Regiment, N.Y.S.V. (1903)
entries.type: published regimental history (by a regiment veteran)
entries.reliability: high — independent published corroboration of the AG roster

hubbell_attestations.verbatim: HUBBELL, HENRY.—Age, 23 years. Enlisted, May 22, 1861, at Champlain, to serve two years; mustered in, Co. D, June 15, 1861; killed, September 17, 1862, at Antietam, Md.
... Hicks, Lawrence — G. / Hubbell, Henry — D. / Jolly, Peter — D. ...
hubbell_attestations.note: Places Henry Hubbell, Co. D, explicitly among the regiment's Antietam KILLED — a second independent attestation. (Note 'Jolly, Peter — D' here matches the 'Peter Jolly' in the garbled NY Herald 1862-09-25 OCR.)

entries.title: Frederick Phisterer, New York in the War of the Rebellion, 1861-1865
entries.type: published state compendium (regimental summaries, no individual rosters)
entries.reliability: high for unit-level facts; does NOT name Hubbell
entries.unit_facts_verbatim: Co. D recruited from Champlain, Clinton co., under Capt. Davis J. Rich; regiment mustered in June 15, 1861, at the Industrial School Barracks, Albany. Antietam: 'the regiment lost thirty-two killed, one hundred and nine wounded and nine missing—total, one hundred and fifty.'

entries.title: Antietam on the Web (AOTW) — soldier profile #8050 + unit #351
entries.type: curated battle database (editor-moderated; transcribed from NY AG report)
entries.reliability: medium-high finding aid; DERIVATIVE of the AG roster (not independent)
entries.hubbell_verbatim: Henry Hubbell, Private, 34th New York Infantry, Company D; 'killed in action on 17 September 1862' at 'Sharpsburg, MD'; (? - 1862). Cites NY Adjutant-General Annual Report (Issue 22, 1900).

entries.title: Civil War Archive — 34th NY regimental record
entries.unit_facts_verbatim: 34th Regiment Infantry 'Herkimer Regiment' — organized at Albany, mustered in June 15, 1861; left for Washington July 3, 1861; Battle of Antietam September 16-17 [1862]; mustered out June 30, 1863.

notes: Chapin (1903) is the key NEW source from the secondary push — it independently corroborates the AG roster AND names Henry in the Antietam killed list. Phisterer and AOTW corroborate unit facts. These are the 'regimental bibliography' for Henry's 34th NY.
